description: Deterministic internal KGW mechanics values for the project's Python-RNG profile. This is not an author-code oracle.

_reference_implementation.note: This fixture intentionally follows Python random.Random.shuffle. It must differ from the pinned author profile, which uses device-bound torch.Generator plus torch.randperm. Author-code oracle values live in kgw_author_torch_2_13_cpu_win_amd64.json.
_reference_implementation.green_list_formula: rng = random.Random(seed); ids = list(range(vocab_size)); rng.shuffle(ids); green_list = sorted(ids[:green_size])
_reference_implementation.detection_formula: For t in range(context_width, len(tokens)): context = tokens[t-context_width:t]; G_t = green_list(context); green_count += tokens[t] in G_t; T += 1. z = (green_count - gamma*T) / sqrt(gamma*(1-gamma)*T); p = 1 - Phi(z).
